Imagine - Zookeeper.name: Imagine: Zookeeper
Imagine - Zookeeper.summary: Continuing along the Imagine series, Imagine Zookeeper lets you run your own animal reserve on your DS.

Londonian Gothics - Meikyuu no Lolita.name: Londonian Gothics: Meikyuu no Lolita
Londonian Gothics - Meikyuu no Lolita.summary: Alice's father has been kidnapped by creatures of the night, and it is unknown whether he's alive or dead. You, as Alice, insist on following down into the labyrinth via a hole in the basement to find and rescue him. Your lolita dresses contain the powers needed to protect you from the dangers that lurk within.

Mahjong Journey - Quest for Tikal.name: Mahjong Journey: Quest for Tikal
Mahjong Journey - Quest for Tikal.summary:
Nine adventurous game modes, including Classic and Adventure.
Play one of the most popular casual game genres, now on the most popular casual game platform.
More than 300 puzzle layouts to solve.
Five tile sets to unlock.
Three difficulty levels.

Matchstick.name: Matchstick
Matchstick.summary: The aim of the Matchstick Puzzle by DS is to answer the questions by moving or rotating matchsticks. There are more than 150 puzzles of four difficulty settings to complete. The game also has hints to help the player decipher the more abstract clues.

Top Gun.name: Top Gun
Top Gun.summary: Based on the 80s movie of the same name, this fighter aircraft simulator game offers 10 single-player levels consisting on dogfights, escort missions, target destroy missions, air-to-ground bombings, et cetera. It also features a multiplayer dogfighting mode with up to 4 players. The game plays from a 3rd person point of view of the fighter and is rendered in full 3D.
